newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Menem aide to meet industry chiefs on labor talks.
newsitem.headline: Menem aide to meet industry chiefs on labor talks.

text.p: President Carlos Menem's Cabinet Chief Jorge Rodriguez will meet Argentina's Group of Eight business lobby at 1800 local/2100 GMT Tuesday to pave the way for talks with trade unions on labor reforms.

Government officials said the meeting with the Group of Eight, made up of the heads of the country's main business and industry chambers, would also include Interior Minister Carlos Corach and Labor Minister Armando Caro Figueroa.

The Peronist government and the main CGT labor federation, at loggerheads over plans to fight unemployment by modernizing labor legislation, agreed last week to resume dialogue which was interrupted by the CGT's December 26 strike.
The three-way talks are expected to begin next week, though a date has not yet been set.
